in_hebrew.name: Mair
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bright or radiant
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mair הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Welsh word ‘mawr’, meaning ‘great’ or ‘large’. The name Mair is often translated as ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘radiant’. In Welsh folklore, Mair was also the name of a fairy queen.

The name Mair is often translated as ‘bright’, ‘shining’, or ‘radiant’. In Welsh folklore, Mair was also the name of a fairy queen.
